description: This source file defines the code-behind for the AdminPanel web page in an ASP.NET Web Forms application. It contains event handlers for button clicks that perform server transfers to different pages within the Online Examination System.

classes.name: AdminPanel
classes.description: Code-behind class for the AdminPanel ASP.NET page, handling page load and button click events for navigation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Event handler that is called when the page loads.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Event handler for the Home button; currently does nothing.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Event handler that transfers server to AdminQueue.aspx.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Event handler that transfers server to AdminLeaderboard.aspx.

methods.name: sExamB_Click
methods.description: Event handler that transfers server to SetExam.aspx.

methods.name: eExamB_Click
methods.description: Event handler that transfers server to EditExam.aspx.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Event handler that transfers server to LoginPage.aspx, effectively logging out the user.
